config.contrast_threshold: Bonferroni two-sided normal across fitted unordered pairs; candidate upper>=-tau, strict lower>tau
config.covariance: inverse weighted profile Gram matrix using absolute supplied sigma; no empirical scale
config.endpoint: largest modeled integrated signal across the 82 released channels; not total atmospheric mass
config.fit_admission: finite positive sigma; finite full-rank converged fit/covariance; shared nonnegativity; inclusive Q gate
config.native_mass_placeholder: TMAC=1 only for ignored native percent_mass diagnostic, never an endpoint
config.no_nominal_guarantee: profile selection, fit gates, model misspecification and release error mismatch preclude automatic nominal interpretation
config.nonnegativity: exclude fit below -tau; retain/count tiny negative values without clipping
config.pairwise_denominators: all ten source pairs and fitted pairs (six when source4 omitted) separately
config.public_scope: configuration, hashes, tests and aggregate metrics only; all full arrays and row decisions private
config.truth_set_coverage: all true co-leaders must be in prediction set; empty failures never covered
config.winner: minimum Q among shared-admissible fits, index tie-break; separate numerical pre-admission diagnostic
config.wrong_singleton: predicted singleton is not a true co-leader; zero singleton denominator gives null
